Root combined controller checking draft. This file imports already produced
ordinary candidate139 modules through that candidate's native Lake environment.
It writes no compiled project output and changes no source in the frozen tree.
A focused pass is not whole-candidate acceptance. The public ordinary owner
files and connected fixture clients remain separately staged for integration.

/-!
# Exact reflection of native primitive machines

UNCOMPILED research proposal, prepared 24 November 2026. This is not an
installed owner or an acceptance result. No compiler was run by its author.
The proposed ordinary owner is
Applications/Resources/TuringSimulation/TapeReflection.lean.

The entire tape is reflected about its current head. The actual native
transition changes only move directions; control, writes and the supplied
default remain unchanged. Optional iteration and actual witness counts are
transported literally, including live endpoints and outer none.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

/-!
# Ordinary designated input for the reflected native stack simulator

UNCOMPILED research proposal. Expected clocks and complete boundary tapes were
fixed in EXPECTATIONS.json before any compiler feedback. This file was not
compiled by its author and is not an installed source owner.

The input alphabet is a fixed per-letter injection into the finite working
alphabet. Input order and length are unchanged; false is a present symbol and
none is blank. The actual prelude scans to the first blank, moves back once,
and writes the marker. The resulting entire tape is the reflection of trInit.
The main phase reflects every native move. A final native write can normalize
an already established singleton output tape; outer none is one step later.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

/-!
# Complete singleton tapes at related stack halts

UNCOMPILED research proposal. No compiler was run by its author. This is not an
installed owner or an acceptance result. The proposed reusable ordinary owner
is Applications/Resources/TuringSimulation/SingletonOutput.lean.

The output argument needs every stack, not merely a head observation. The
existing complete TrCfg relation and a family of at-most-one-element stacks
force every tape cell away from the bottom to be blank. A later actual native
write can therefore normalize the complete output tape in one primitive step.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

/-!
# Native composition for the marked-input wrapper

UNCOMPILED research proposal. No compiler was run by its author. These proof
bodies consume an actual source EvalsTo witness and its live endpoint. The
source transition returning none is deliberately intercepted by one actual
output write. Reflection itself preserves outer none, but the wrapper does not.

The controller must derive the singleton endpoint and stopped premise from its
existing full TrCfg and support-closed run. These generic composition theorems
are not a replacement for that concrete instantiation.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

/-!
# Independently fixed ordinary-input boundary cases

UNCOMPILED research clients. The literal input words, complete endpoint tapes
and exact prelude counts were fixed in EXPECTATIONS.json before compiler
feedback. The source is finite, with two Boolean-indexed Boolean stores and a
supplied true control default. These are prelude/output interface cases; they
do not claim controller reachability for the selected artificial source.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

namespace Examples.MarkedInputResearch

/-!
# Fixed ordinary native interface for an arbitrary finite stack package

UNCOMPILED implementation-assistance draft. EXPECTATIONS.json was frozen
before this implementation. No source owner is installed by this file.

The source package, output-letter conversion and fallback are fixed before
any raw input. Alphabet finiteness is supplied at every stack index. Input is
the existing injective per-letter symbol map, with unchanged order and length.
The actual prelude, reflected native simulation and output write are charged
by the companion run API. Input and output stack alphabets may differ.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

/-!
# Actual ordinary runs from full native package witnesses

UNCOMPILED implementation assistance. SingletonOutputSupport is a proposed
generic owner boundary, not an installed file. Its two required declarations
are the exact generic SingletonOutput namespace block in the frozen
decider-research/repair1/ControllerOrdinary.lean. Include that block once when
combining, or use its root-validated generic owner after extraction.

Every run below consumes the actual primitive EvalsToInTime witness and full
TrCfg relation. No source timing predicate is substituted for execution. The
full output tape is obtained before the output write, and the stored native
count is retained throughout endpoint transport.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true

/-!
# Independently fixed ordinary-package interface cases

UNCOMPILED implementation assistance. These statements implement the literal
expectations frozen in EXPECTATIONS.json before OrdinaryPackage.lean existed.

The two-stack fixture has input alphabet Option Bool and output alphabet Bool.
Its main label and register are both true. The transition program halts at
every source label: this file claims actual prelude and output-boundary runs,
not an input-to-singleton run that this fixture cannot supply. Stored-count
examples below are literal arithmetic consequences of the generic count API.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true
